subject: Number of assigned is greater than total number of reads ?

messages.author: 00f0644c13d49788
messages.subject: Number of assigned is greater than total number of reads ?
parts:
Hi, I enjoy subread to analyze RNA-seq. However, I recently got weird results from featureCounts.

One of my RNA-seq sample was aligned by STAR and was counted by featureCounts for gencode gene annotation. It is paired-end 75bp.

As you see in the following logs from STAR and featureCounts, the number of assigned in featureCounts is greater than the total number of reads in STAR log. Do you have any clue?

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Number of assigned is greater than total number of reads ?
parts: This is because featureCounts reports number of alignments but STAR reports number of reads. A multi-mapping read gives rise to more than one alignment and therefore you see higher counts with featureCounts.
